hypotheses.claim: Frank v0.1 must have exactly one CURRENT identity authority path: owner-fixed self.root source -> repository semantic transaction/history -> materializer -> UnifiedDB/derived ClayGraph -> boot/runtime projection; direct DB identity mutation or provider/node identity are non-authoritative.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The stale DU-FRANK-7.1 master/current-main surfaces are compatibility-only and cannot affect authoritative boot/runtime identity, so source/replay repair is unnecessary.

hypotheses.claim: Every new external effect attempt must be fenced to the current self.root execution lease epoch, while verified outcome reconciliation after a provider attempt must remain possible after lease turnover.
support: target-VPS stale-holder counterexample admitted old reservation into COMMITTING
active V16/V17 repair lanes bind reservation/start/execute to presence epoch
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The physical Linux flock/global-busy process gate alone prevents stale external effects, making semantic effect fencing redundant.
hypotheses.falsifier: Demonstrate under crash/takeover and cross-process replay that physical gating alone rejects every stale reservation/start/retry before provider emission while preserving reconciliation and idempotency.

hypotheses.claim: German<->ClayCode acceptance requires an independently derived source-to-hard-semantic validator or equivalent independent oracle; same-codec roundtrip consistency is insufficient.
support: 100000-case SPL synthetic proxy: same-codec roundtrip false-accepted every injected active hard-field corruption
independent full validator detected all modeled corruptions with zero false deny and lower proxy latency
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Real German distributions will make same-codec roundtrip sufficient because systematic common-mode errors are negligible.
hypotheses.falsifier: Real German held-out/common-mode fault corpus on target VPS shows roundtrip-only matches independent validation on hard-field false-allow/false-deny and resource bounds.

hypotheses.claim: ClayCode effect authority must bind not only root source identity but transitive dependency closure and indirect references; otherwise trusted root code can call drifted/untrusted effectful dependencies.
support: latest WP04 branch adds indirect-reference gate and transitive dependency-closure hashing specifically to falsify source-only trust
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Direct typed effect checks at the root module are sufficient because dependency resolution is immutable or already covered elsewhere.
hypotheses.falsifier: Mutate a transitive dependency or route an effectful function through an indirect reference while keeping trusted root bytes fixed; if current WP04 still denies safely without closure/reference checks, the added mechanism is redundant.

hypotheses.claim: Fusion completion is unsound unless scientific-branch membership tracks the current registry taxonomy; the pre-run validator can silently under-cover the mesh.
support: current registry renamed/added whole-target, domain-build, direct-validation, multimodal, and integrated-frank kinds
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Only the four domain_research branches are intended scientific branches and all others are meta/implementation triggers that need no feedback receipt.
hypotheses.falsifier: Owner/current protocol explicitly limits branch feedback to those four and demonstrates that omitted Frank/ClayCode/UnifiedDB/Harness/Q23 results cannot change whole-mesh conclusions.

hypotheses.claim: Current MCP v0.2 evidence proves package/preflight viability on the accepted VPS but not deployed-service readiness; privilege admission is the blocking boundary, not Python package correctness.
